annotations.title: See what Bucky has mapped for a city

description: Public city catalogue inventory. Pass a city name or a latitude and longitude. A city name with multiple matches returns choices; after the user chooses, call again with that candidate geoDivisionId. Never pass a slug. Shows datasets grouped by topic as on file, not loaded yet, unavailable, or not confirmed. This is city coverage, not lot feasibility or operator health. If Bucky has not mapped the place, the result points to recording demand. It does not record demand by itself.
name: cityInventory
